describe.doc: Describe schema and prior evidence without reading memory.

read.doc: Create a bounded read job; advance with job.step().

observe.doc: Runtime-scheduled read observation; default 60 update seconds.

enumerate_primary_weapons.doc: Enumerate structurally owned weapon resources through one bounded shared discovery pass.

map_primary_weapons.doc: Schedule one read-only primary weapon enumeration after a startup delay.

capture_snapshot.doc: Incrementally capture committed readable current-process regions to a build-bound HD2SNAP file.

patch.doc: Freshly resolve and apply one reviewed scalar or typed-reference change.

transaction.doc: Validate every change before writing; guarded rollback on failure.

plan.doc: Coordinate ordered semantic operations across multiple related backing objects and phases.

ensure.doc: Wrap exactly one patch, transaction, or composition plan. The first run is fully guarded; afterwards only the applied target bytes are re-checked, backing off from interval (default 60 s) to max_interval (default 600 s). Drift triggers the full guarded path again; conflicts are terminal. Each guarded run retries transient not-ready failures up to 6 attempts, 5 s apart.

metrics.doc: Process-wide counters (scans, lookups, hashes, writes, verifications, scheduler ticks) and worst durations for performance audits.

read_target.doc: Return a public read/observe target containing all mapped fields in this domain.

describe.doc: Describe mapped domain fields without process access.
